value.rationale: Full natural associator-word distribution for every finite Chein double, rather than another scalar associativity degree. The seven-sector decomposition gives every attainable value, exact multiplicities, generated associator subloop, and nontrivial conjugacy class variation (explicit in S4). It provides structural information not recoverable from the known identity-fiber probability.
